graders.name: billing-file-rules
graders.criteria: Judge `src/billing/AGENTS.md`. It keeps, with their meaning: every change to `src/billing/` needs a migration note in `docs/billing-changes.md`, newest entry first; refunds over 500.00 require the `manual_review` flag set to `True`. The integer-cents, currency-code and card-number logging rules may appear here, in the root AGENTS.md, or both.

graders.name: billing-moved-out
graders.description: The billing-only migration and refund rules no longer sit in the root file.

graders.name: keeps-api-rules
graders.description: Both API rules stay in the root file.

graders.name: keeps-commit-rule
graders.description: The universal commit rule stays in AGENTS.md.

graders.name: keeps-make-test
graders.description: The universal test rule stays in AGENTS.md.

graders.name: keeps-push-rule
graders.description: The universal push rule stays in AGENTS.md.

graders.name: loads-context-design
graders.description: Process check: The agent read `references/context-design.md` of the skill, as the References table requires here.

graders.name: money-rules-kept
graders.criteria: Across the two files, the integer-cents and currency-code rules (including the `InvalidCurrency` error) are still stated, and any of them that code outside `src/billing/` needs stays in the root file.

graders.name: report
graders.criteria: The final message says which rules moved to `src/billing/AGENTS.md` and which stayed in the root file, and accounts for all five billing rules.

graders.name: root-file
graders.criteria: Judge the root AGENTS.md. It keeps the push, `make test`, Conventional Commits and both API rules; it no longer carries the migration-note and refund rules in full; it points to `src/billing/AGENTS.md` with a condition that names billing work or `src/billing/`; and it still requires never logging full card numbers (only the last four digits), because `src/api/routes.py` logs card data. The integer-cents and currency-code rules may stay here or move to the billing file.

graders.name: root-pointer
graders.description: The root file points to the billing file, since agents read only the root file.
